properties.name: Horseman's Camp

properties.name: Equestrian Camp and Day Use
properties.desc: Equestrian Camp sites are primitive but restrooms are nearby. Bridle trails nearby. Reservations are required and may be made up to six months ahead. Tie lines, fire pits, picnic tables.

properties.name: Equestrian Camp and Day Use
properties.desc: Equestrian camp is on its own road separate from family campground. 20 Non-electric sites. Fire ring and picnic table at each site. Restroom has flush toilets. Reservations up to 6 months in advance. Availability limited in winter (Nov-Mar).

properties.name: Paddle Creek Horse Camp
properties.desc: Large level field with ample area for trailers and horses. Some hitching rails are provided. This camping area is open year-round and is kept mowed and has a capacity for approximately 100 people and horses to camp. Vault toilet.

properties.name: Kinderhook Horse Trailhead
properties.desc: No fee primitive camping at trailhead. Water for horses only.

properties.name: Bear Lake Horse Camp
properties.desc:
Horse camp in state forest has 58 campsites with tie rails,
latrines, and water for horses. Forest has 70+ miles of bridle trails, most directly accessible from camp. Campsites available on a first-come, first-served basis.

properties.name: Tar Hollow Horse Camp
properties.desc: Primitive horse camping in shady, grassy sites. No electricity. Pit latrines, no drinking water but horse water. Tie Lines. 46 sites. No reservations; can be very busy.

properties.name: Zaleski Forest Horse Camp
properties.desc: Horse camp offers 16 sites, latrines, picnic tables, fire rings, and hitching posts. Sites available first-come, first-served. Campers must register on-site. Campers must have a horse to camp at this location.

properties.name: Trail Riders Campground
properties.desc: Campground equipped with picnic tables, fire rings, and vault latrines. No drinking water; horse water available. 20 sites accommodating family and/or horse campers. Campers must self-register. Space for large rigs is limited.

properties.name: Ronsheim Campground
properties.desc: Campground with 7 family sites. Self registration. Horse water but no drinking water. No fee. Pit latrines, picnic tables, fire pits. Trail Riders' Camp is at west end of horse trails.
